summary: Klarna Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on 22 June. Holders representing ~72.3% of total voting rights participated; all 12 resolutions passed with at least 99% support. The filing is a routine post-meeting disclosure of voting outcomes on standard items (accounts, remuneration, auditor reappointment, director re-elections, share allotment authority). No special-situation event is present. As a foreign private issuer report of routine AGM results, it maps to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07 disclosure of shareholder votes. This is a procedural compliance filing with no transactional or strategic catalyst.
